theorems.name: CRT separation of C6 and C12
theorems.statement: C6 is canonically C3 x C2, C12 is canonically C3 x C4, and reduction C12 -> C6 is id_C3 x (C4 -> C2).

theorems.name: Exact non-split root cover
theorems.statement: The reduction C12 -> C6 is surjective with kernel {0,6}; no lift of the C6 generator is annihilated by six, hence the extension has no group-homomorphic section.

theorems.name: Quarter-turn root torsor
theorems.statement: The equation 2q=6 in C12 has exactly q=3,9; they reduce to the C6 half-turn, differ by the kernel element, and are exchanged freely by inversion.

theorems.name: Three-bit tetrahedral graph holonomy
theorems.statement: C1(K4;F2) modulo vertex-frame coboundaries is classified by the three triangular holonomies adjacent to A; every three-bit code occurs and the fourth face is their sum.

theorems.name: Filled-tetrahedron face-flatness criterion
theorems.statement: An overlap-sign one-cochain globalizes to local root signs on the four slices if and only if all triangular face holonomies vanish.

theorems.name: Global signed root unique up to reversal
theorems.statement: Two vertex-root assignments induce the same overlap signs exactly when they are equal or simultaneous global reversals.

theorems.name: Face transport detects chirality holonomy
theorems.statement: Transporting a local quarter-turn root around a triangular face flips its sign exactly when that face holonomy is nonzero.

theorems.name: Projective Euler endpoint descent
theorems.statement: Both quarter-turn roots and every sign-transported root double to the same half-turn state; scalar half-period output is chirality-even even when a signed root does not globalize.

theorems.name: Single-seed propagation boundary
theorems.statement: After a global choice between +/-J, the already established positive-longitudinal/equal-resultant section propagates every non-antipodal Viète root; the independent sign choice occurs only at the antipodal seed.
theorems.boundary: The deep algebraic orientation states are not yet exact integer native Cell/trace addresses.
